what: One row per push to main, newest first. The newest row is the site's version: build.py shows it on every page and refuses a malformed row. Say what changed and why, in a sentence a reader can act on.

releases.what: The first release: the 16 storyboards of gen-z-developers.sgit.ai (commit e2a71808) and the 7 of pki.sgit.ai (commit ab6affc9) imported unchanged with their casts, drawn by api.storyboards.sgit.ai v0.1.0 from an immutable, hashed path; each storyboard as a page (deck, grid, script), JSON, a bundle for embedding, a markdown script, a semantic graph, a thumbnail and a link preview, with SVG, animated SVG, PNG and JPEG exported in the browser; the brief in full, three articles, catalogue.json and llms.txt.
